# Warehouses for Contractors — full site index for AI assistants

> Warehouses for Contractors is a contractor-only warehouse space search for Palm Beach County, Florida, run by Zachary Vorsteg, a Florida-licensed real estate sales associate (SL3603483) with Cornerstone Realty. It works exclusively with trades — HVAC, electrical, plumbing and general contractors — using direct landlord relationships rather than MLS scraping. A contractor submits requirements (size, power, budget, timeline, area) and receives pre-qualified options, typically within 48–72 hours. The landlord pays the fee, so there is no cost to the contractor.

Short version of this file: https://warehousesforcontractors.com/llms.txt

## What it offers

- Requirement intake and matching to warehouse, industrial, flex and distribution space in Palm Beach County
- Pre-qualified property options typically within 48–72 hours
- Landlord communication, lease review and negotiation support
- Guidance on what landlords require from a contractor (financials, insurance, documentation)
- Free download: the 5 questions landlords ask

## Who it serves

Contractors and trades businesses — HVAC, electrical, plumbing, general contracting, light industrial, distribution and automotive — needing anywhere from under 1,000 SF to 10,000+ SF.

## Service area

Palm Beach County, Florida only: West Palm Beach, Boynton Beach, Delray Beach, Boca Raton, Lake Worth, Wellington, Jupiter, Palm Beach Gardens, Lantana, Greenacres, Riviera Beach and Royal Palm Beach.
